scope: Independent source-assisted semantic and orthographic review of proposed new SVG errors; no production resource edits.

source_contract.commons_svg_original_size_unavailable: The SVG does not declare a usable original size. No canvas-based size was substituted.
source_contract.commons_svg_original_size_too_large: The original SVG size exceeds Android bitmap dimensions. No resizing was applied.

overall_disposition: Five complete pairs coherent for source-assisted draft inclusion; apply three required corrections to the hak-Latn-TW too-large value. Jeju remains incomplete research only.
acceptance_limits: No native-language acceptance or final localization-completeness claim.
Whole UI sentences are new editorial compositions. Absence of a dictionary quoting each full sentence is not itself evidence of bad meaning.
Existing catalogue occurrences are project terminology clues and may themselves contain errors; exact PFS corrections here demonstrate why reuse is not acceptance.
No Kotlin, Android, font, XML resource build, or runtime check performed in this language review.
No unrelated catalogue entries were changed or proposed for automatic correction.

exact_values.commons_svg_original_size_unavailable: SVG 無提供做得用个原本大細。無用照畫布大細決定个大細來取代。
exact_values.commons_svg_original_size_too_large: SVG 个原本大細超出 Android 點陣圖个尺寸上限。並未調大細。

clause_review: SVG 無提供做得用个原本大細 states that the SVG does not provide usable original size information. 提供 is a coherent ordinary-language alternative to declare in this file context; 做得用 modifies the original size and does not merely claim that any size is absent.

無用照畫布大細決定个大細來取代 negates using a size determined according to the canvas size as a substitute. The relative clause modifies 大細; it does not say the canvas was changed. 無用 ... 來取代 is read compositionally with a following object and purpose phrase, not as the isolated adjective useless, and does not introduce inability.
SVG 个原本大細超出 Android 點陣圖个尺寸上限 keeps original SVG size, Android bitmap, a dimensional maximum, and exceeds. It does not substitute a byte-size or available-memory limit.
並未調大細 reports nonperformance of size adjustment. No automatic-only, shrink-only or future-only qualification is present.
remaining_uncertainty: The repeated 大細 makes the canvas-derived clause somewhat heavy; a fluent Hakka editor may prefer a shorter formulation, but I found no concrete scope or meaning defect.
Technical register and whole-sentence idiom are not certified by constituent dictionaries or by existing project terminology.

exact_values.commons_svg_original_size_unavailable: SVG mò thì-kiûng cho-tet yung ke ngièn-pún thai-se. Mò yung cheu fa-pu thai-se kiet-thin ke thai-se lòi chhí-thoi.
exact_values.commons_svg_original_size_too_large: SVG ke ngièn-pún thai-se chhêu chhut Android tiám chhṳn thù ke chhak-chhun song han. Pin vi thiàu thai-se.

required_corrections.reason: The dot/point reading of 點 is Sixian PFS tiám. The unmarked inherited tiam does not preserve that tone.
上 in the upper-limit meaning is Sixian PFS song, not sông. 限 remains han.

Here 調 means adjust/regulate, the thiàu reading. The tiau reading belongs to a different reading/sense set. MOE tiauˇ is its own romanization of /tʰiau11/; an explicit PFS source gives thiàu, so this is not an unverified mechanical system conversion.

clause_review: The unavailable value pairs with the Han candidate clause by clause, including negated provide, ability-to-use modifier, original size, canvas-based derivation and negated substitution. No required change identified in that value.
The too-large value has the same semantic structure as the Han candidate, but its inherited point, upper and adjust spellings require the three corrections above.

kiet-thin is a complete attested PFS word for 決定; thì-kiûng and chhí-thoi also have explicit PFS lexical support. These are not clipped morphemes mechanically reassembled from another romanization system.
After correction, Pin vi thiàu thai-se retains the unqualified completed non-action meaning. The Han partner 調 need not be changed.
remaining_uncertainty: Hyphenation is inconsistent in the current catalogue (for example fa pu/fa-pu and sông han/sông-han). This review does not impose a new project-wide orthographic convention. The three required changes concern readings, not cosmetic hyphenation.
A fluent PFS editor should still review the complete relative clause and technical noun chain. Current catalogue spellings are terminology clues, not accepted linguistic truth.

exact_values.commons_svg_original_size_unavailable: SVG 空 朱 別 戟 𡱩 㭲 𣎏 体 用. 空 用 戟 𡱩 豫 𨕭 椌 𡳒 抵 𠊝 替.
exact_values.commons_svg_original_size_too_large: 戟 𡱩 㭲 𧵑 SVG 越 過 界限 戟 𡱩 bitmap 𧵑 Android. 空 𢷮 戟 𡱩.

clause_review: SVG không cho biết kích thước gốc có thể dùng retains the file-states-information meaning and the usable-original-size restriction. Cho biết is a coherent paraphrase; it does not assert specific XML syntax.

Không dùng kích thước dựa trên khung vẽ để thay thế explicitly negates use of a canvas-based size as the replacement. Dựa trên attaches to kích thước and để thay thế gives the substitution role; no inability or canvas resizing is claimed.
Kích thước gốc của SVG vượt quá giới hạn kích thước bitmap của Android preserves original size, exceed, the bitmap dimension limit and Android.
Không đổi kích thước is the unqualified no-size-change statement in this error-result context. It neither restricts the claim to automatic shrinking nor promises future behavior.
vi-Hani.additional_evidence: The current ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_s already contains the complete 朱 別 compound in its preview-result sentence, not just 別 in isolation. Keep this catalogue choice rather than replacing it with 别 solely because another dictionary page uses that variant.
remaining_uncertainty: The supplied Quốc-ngữ reading is coherent; final Nôm orthographic/typographic acceptance remains separate.
Existing mixed word/syllable spacing and the technical Latin token bitmap are preserved. A Nôm reader should still review readability and app font rendering. No font or runtime check was performed.

exact_values.commons_svg_original_size_too_large: SVG ཡི་ཐོག་མའི་ཆེ་ཆུང་ནི་ Android གྱི་ bitmap ཆེ་ཆུང་གི་ཚད་ལས་བརྒལ་ཡོད། ཆེ་ཆུང་མ་བསྒྱུར།

clause_review: SVG ནང་ locates the missing information in the SVG. སྤྱོད་རུང་བའི་ modifies ཐོག་མའི་ཆེ་ཆུང་ and བཀོད་མེད expresses no recorded/stated usable original size. This is a coherent declaration paraphrase, not merely an absent display or a claim that SVG cannot have a size.

རས་གཞིའི་ཆེ་ཆུང་གཞིར་བཟུང་བའི་ modifies the following size as canvas-size-based. ཚབ་ཏུ་ supplies the substitute role and མ་སྤྱད negates past use. It does not say substitution is impossible or request a substitute.

The second message makes original SVG size the subject and uses ཚད་ལས་བརྒལ་ཡོད for exceeding the bitmap size limit belonging to Android. The explicit size noun prevents replacing the claim with a file-byte limit.
ཆེ་ཆུང་མ་བསྒྱུར retains no change of size. The past-form phrasing in this result context is consistent with a non-action report rather than a requested resizing operation.
remaining_uncertainty: The repeated size noun and compact bitmap-size-limit compound deserve fluent-editor polish; I found no concrete semantic weakening.
No native Tibetan acceptance or official modern technical-sentence certification is claimed. The whole sentence is editorial composition, not a quotation.

exact_values.commons_svg_original_size_too_large: SVG གི་ཚད་ངོ་མ་འདི་ Android གི་ bitmap ཚད་ཀྱི་ཁྱབ་ཁོངས་ལས་བརྒལ་ཡོད། ཚད་བསྒྱུར་མ་འབད།

clause_review: ལག་ལེན་འཐབ་བཏུབ་མི་ is an ability-to-use relative modifier of ཚད་ངོ་མ་. SVG ནང་ལུ་ and གསལ་བཀོད་འབད་དེ་མེད together express that usable original size has not been specified in the SVG. The specify predicate has independent Dzongkha computing/dimension-setting support.

འབྲི་གཞི་གི་ཚད་ལུ་གཞི་བཞག་སྟེ་བཟོ་མི་ཚད་ཅིག་ denotes a size made on the basis of the canvas size. The object is that derived size, not the canvas. ཚབ་སྦེ་ལག་ལེན་མ་འཐབ negates using it as a substitute in this failure-report context.
The original SVG size exceeds the range of Android bitmap size. The size-plus-range phrase stays dimensional; no byte count or available-memory-budget qualification is introduced.
ཚད་བསྒྱུར་མ་འབད states that size adjustment was not performed. It retains the full non-resizing claim and does not use the neighboring Tibetan predicate in its place.
remaining_uncertainty: The nested relative clause and technical dimension-range noun phrase need fluent Dzongkha idiom/register review. They are compositionally coherent, but no full-sentence native acceptance is claimed.
Some older LibreOffice Dzongkha surrounding text contains obvious unrelated translation/OCR problems; only the specifically readable matching predicates are supporting evidence.

jje.reason: The input contains only a proposed too-large message. No independently justified unavailable-size/canvas-substitution pair was established in this review. Do not count Jeju as covered or manufacture its missing value.
